name: Thane Du-Moriss IV
description: The human ruling wizard of Kieve, husband of Bayende; a non-planeswalker who travels the planes searching for his rival Noranda-Zang.

description_citations.text: "Thane Du-Moriss IV". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thane defeated Noranda-Zang in the War of Thanopolis and thrust a sword into his heart, but Zang had prepared to transfer his soul to a new body.
timeline.quote: Thane defeated his rival Noranda-Zang in the War of Thanopolis and thrust a sword into his heart, ostensibly killing him.

citation.text: "Thane Du-Moriss IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Noranda-Zang killed Thane's wife Bayende and their unborn son.

citation.text: "Thane Du-Moriss IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thane searched the planes for Zang for seventeen years.
timeline.quote: For seventeen years, Thane searched for Zang.

citation.text: "Thane Du-Moriss IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thane stumbled into Everlorne and used Nightmares summoned with the Blue Realm to kill a horned octopus in a whirlwind.
timeline.quote: Thane used his amulet to summon two Nightmares to fight the octopus.

citation.text: "Thane Du-Moriss IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thane drove off the castle guards with a swarm of locusts and unbarred the door.
timeline.quote: Thane clutched the Blue Realm to summon a swarm of locusts.

citation.text: "Thane Du-Moriss IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thane cast a death spell that killed Zang's only son in revenge.
timeline.quote: He cast a death spell that killed Zang's son.

citation.text: "Thane Du-Moriss IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
